summary.text: Andy Ferrari is the Democratic candidate for the Florida House of Representatives, District 27, in the November 3, 2026 general election, against Republican incumbent Richard Gentry.

paragraphs.text: Ferrari ran for the same seat in 2024 and lost the general election to Richard Gentry, receiving 30.1% of the vote (30,707 votes) to Gentry's 67.9%.
Libertarian Dennis Simpson Jr. also appeared on that ballot.
